Definition:
Logical model for the pregnancy-status data.

This is the minimal data set for the pregnancy status (consumed, for example, via
Vitalink FHIR / MAGDA / VUTG / mijnburgerprofiel.be / mijngezondheid.be /
caregivers).
The patient who is pregnant. The reference may identify the patient by pseudonymised SSIN, depending on the implementation.

Short: The healthcare professional who takes responsibility for the recording of the pregnancy information
Definition: The healthcare professional who takes responsibility for the recording of the pregnancy information
The last date on which the pregnant woman was observed by her gynaecologist or midwife during the pregnancy.
The date the pregnancy was first registered in the system. This is not the date the pregnancy was observed, but the date it was entered in the system for the first time.
Observation conveying the current pregnancy status of the woman at the date of observation (e.g. pregnant, not pregnant). Bound to SNOMED CT, EHDS Patient Summary aligned.
Coded pregnancy status (e.g. pregnant, not pregnant).

Short: Practitioner who recorded the pregnancy status
Definition: Practitioner who recorded the pregnancy status
The date the pregnancy began, usually estimated as the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) or from an early ultrasound.
The date the practitioner expects the delivery, usually etimated from the ultrasound. It normally does not change after the initial etimation; the actual delivery date is typically within ±2 weeks.
The actual end date of the pregnancy.
The number of births the practitioner expects in the delivery, usually estimated from the ultrasound.
